classification-blank-profile: Invalid configuration: classification.profile must be a non-empty string.
classification-entity-source-with-profil: Invalid configuration: classification.profile cannot be combined with source entity.
classification-not-string-or-object: Invalid configuration: classification must be a string or object.
classification-shorthand-custom: Invalid configuration: classification "custom" requires the object form.
classification-shorthand-profile: Invalid configuration: classification "profile" requires the object form.
classification-unknown-key: Invalid configuration: classification.bogus is not a supported option.
classification-unknown-profile-for-metri: Invalid configuration: classification profile "greenhouse" is not available for metric kind "temperature".
classification-unknown-source: Invalid configuration: classification.source must be "auto", "entity", "profile", or "custom".
config-is-an-array: Invalid configuration: card configuration must be an object.
config-not-an-object: Invalid configuration: card configuration must be an object.
custom-band-min-not-below-max: Invalid configuration: classification.bands.comfort must have min < max.
custom-bands-missing: Invalid configuration: classification.bands must be an object.
custom-default-tier-not-last: Invalid configuration: classification.tiers[0] default tier must be the final tier.
custom-icons-list-without-a-default-tier: Invalid configuration: classification.icons must contain exactly one final default tier.
custom-icons-not-a-list: Invalid configuration: classification.icons must be a list of {min, icon} tiers with a final {default: true, icon} entry.
custom-icons-threshold-object-not-descen: Invalid configuration: classification.icons must descend from fire to low.
custom-icons-threshold-object-on-a-non-t: Invalid configuration: classification.icons must be a list of {min, icon} tiers with a final {default: true, icon} entry.
custom-no-default-tier: Invalid configuration: classification.tiers must contain exactly one final default tier.
custom-one-sided-without-an-anchor: Invalid configuration: classification.scale.one_sided requires an anchored axis, because it keeps the lower bound at classification.scale.min.
custom-optimal-not-contained-in-comfort: Invalid configuration: classification.bands.optimal must be fully contained in classification.bands.comfort.
custom-profile-collapses-when-projected-: Invalid configuration: classification profile for "temperature" becomes degenerate when rounded to °F (tier thresholds collapse near 72°F) — configure wider gaps, or set classification.unit to "°F" directly to avoid rounding.
custom-scale-range-with-anchor-scale-fal: Invalid configuration: classification.scale must not define min or max when anchor_scale is false, because an axis either covers a declared range or follows the data.
custom-scale-step-not-positive: Invalid configuration: classification.scale.step must be greater than zero.
custom-scale-without-a-range: Invalid configuration: classification.scale must define min and max, or set anchor_scale: false to let the axis follow the data.
custom-tier-invalid-color: Invalid configuration: classification.tiers[0].color must be a 3/4/6/8-digit hex color.
custom-tier-unknown-zone: Invalid configuration: classification.tiers[0].zone must be one of "optimal", "comfort", "outside", or "invalid".
custom-tiers-not-strictly-descending: Invalid configuration: classification.tiers must use unique min values in strictly descending order.
custom-unit-belongs-to-another-metric-ki: Invalid configuration: custom classification unit belongs to "humidity", not detected metric kind "temperature".
custom-unit-missing: Invalid configuration: classification.unit must be a recognized unit string.
custom-unit-unknown: Invalid configuration: classification.unit "hPa" is not recognized.
custom-valid-range-without-bounds: Invalid configuration: classification.valid_range must define min and/or max.
entity-blank: Invalid configuration: entity must be an entity id string.
entity-missing: Invalid configuration: at least one current-value source is required — set entity, or add at least one entry to rooms.
entity-not-a-string: Invalid configuration: entity must be an entity id string.
null-config-has-no-entity: Invalid configuration: at least one current-value source is required — set entity, or add at least one entry to rooms.
range-entity-not-a-string: Invalid configuration: range_entity must be an entity id string.
room-entity-duplicated: Invalid configuration: duplicate rooms[].entity "sensor.r1" — each room must reference a unique entity.
room-entity-missing: Invalid configuration: rooms[0].entity must be a non-empty entity id.
room-not-an-object: Invalid configuration: rooms[0] must be an object.
rooms-not-an-array: Invalid configuration: rooms must be an array.
trend-entity-not-a-string: Invalid configuration: trend_entity must be an entity id string.
